findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: the review node on revision-35236165 found that the two-pass redaction I had just introduced leaked a credential the joined-only form hid — the element pass let rule 2 consume the element `Authorization: Bearer`, so the scheme word was gone from the joined line and the following token survived; fixed by leaving such an element intact, plus two smaller findings (the notice fired before the audit write, and the new limitation section overstated flag-value coverage). Re-sealing.
